Paige Anderson Makeup and Hair

$250 bride

Oak Cliff makeup and hair studio traveling on location across DFW. The site says Paige has more than 16 years of bridal work and offers natural, soft glam, full glam, and airbrush.

Bridal makeup starts at $250 per bride, and trials start at $450. Full hair and makeup with Paige starts at $750. Bridal-party services start at $125. Travel is $3 per mile from the Dallas studio. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
